info.title: Google Cloud Support API

requests.description: Retrieve valid classifications to be used when creating a support case. The classications are hierarchical, with each classification containing all levels of the hierarchy, separated by " > ". For example "Technical Issue > Compute > Compute Engine".
requests.name: GET /v2beta/caseClassifications:search

requests.description: Search cases using the specified query.
requests.name: GET /v2beta/cases:search
GET /v2beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update the specified case. Only a subset of fields can be updated.
requests.name: PATCH /v2beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: POST /v2beta/{name}:close
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Download a file attachment on a case. Note: HTTP requests must append "?alt=media" to the URL.
requests.name: GET /v2beta/{name}:download
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Escalate a case. Escalating a case will initiate the Cloud Support escalation management process. This operation is only available to certain Customer Care tiers. Go to https://cloud.google.com/support and look for 'Technical support escalations' in the feature list to find out which tiers are able to perform escalations.
requests.name: POST /v2beta/{name}:escalate
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieve all attachments associated with a support case.
requests.name: GET /v2beta/{parent}/attachments
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Create a file attachment on a case or Cloud resource. The attachment object must have the following fields set: filename.
requests.name: POST /v2beta/{parent}/attachments
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieve all cases under the specified parent. Note: Listing cases under an Organization returns only the cases directly parented by that organization. To retrieve all cases under an organization, including cases parented by projects under that organization, use `cases.search`.
requests.name: GET /v2beta/{parent}/cases
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Create a new case and associate it with the given Cloud resource. The case object must have the following fields set: display_name, description, classification, and severity.
requests.name: POST /v2beta/{parent}/cases
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_SUPPORT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
